name: Copper/Gold Ratio as SPY Leading Indicator
description: Research study analyzing the copper/gold ratio as a leading indicator for SPY equity returns. Computes the HG/GC ratio, its 60-day rate of change, and 20-day forward SPY returns. Outputs include a time-series chart of the ratio and ROC, a scatter plot of ROC vs forward returns with regression line, and a summary table breaking down average forward returns and hit rates by rising vs falling ratio regimes.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO AS SPY LEADING INDICATOR
# =============================================================================
# Hypothesis: Rising copper/gold ratio (risk appetite) leads to positive SPY
# returns. Falling ratio signals defensive positioning and weaker equities.
#
# Copper: HG futures (continuous, unadjusted for cross-commodity ratio)
# Gold: GC futures (continuous, unadjusted for cross-commodity ratio)
# SPY: reference stock
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary Asset (SPY) ---
spy_src = market_data_source()()
close_spy = spy_src.c

# --- Copper (HG) via reference futures + continuation ---
hg_ref = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_ref.o, hg_ref.h, hg_ref.l, hg_ref.c, hg_ref.v, hg_ref.oi, hg_ref.s)
close_hg = ffill(hg_cont.c)

# --- Gold (GC) via reference futures + continuation ---
gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)
close_gc = ffill(gc_cont.c)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# COPPER/GOLD RATIO & 60-DAY ROC
# =============================================================================

cu_au_ratio = close_hg / close_gc

# 60-day rate of change: (ratio / ratio_60d_ago - 1) * 100
ratio_60d_ago = cu_au_ratio >> 60
roc_60d = (cu_au_ratio / ratio_60d_ago - 1) * 100

# =============================================================================
# 20-DAY FORWARD SPY RETURN (look-ahead)
# =============================================================================

spy_fwd_close = close_spy << 20
fwd_spy_20d = (spy_fwd_close / close_spy - 1) * 100

# =============================================================================
# REGIME FLAG
# =============================================================================

ratio_rising = 1.0 if roc_60d > 0 else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CONDITIONAL METRICS FOR SUMMARY TABLE
# =============================================================================

# Rolling Pearson correlation between ratio ROC and forward SPY return
corr_roc_fwd = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=roc_60d, y=fwd_spy_20d)

# Observation counter (1 per valid bar)
obs_count = 1.0 if roc_60d > -9999 else 0.0

# When ratio is rising (ROC > 0)
fwd_spy_rising = where(roc_60d > 0, fwd_spy_20d)
hit_rising = where(roc_60d > 0, 1.0 if fwd_spy_20d > 0 else 0.0)
rising_count = where(roc_60d > 0, 1.0)

# When ratio is falling (ROC <= 0)
fwd_spy_falling = where(roc_60d <= 0, fwd_spy_20d)
hit_falling = where(roc_60d <= 0, 1.0 if fwd_spy_20d > 0 else 0.0)
falling_count = where(roc_60d <= 0, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Copper/Gold Ratio & 60d ROC Over Time
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Copper/Gold Ratio & 60-Day Rate of Change',
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    y_axis_label='Ratio / ROC (%)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cu/Au Ratio', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d ROC (%)', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero ROC')
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, cu_au_ratio, roc_60d)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Scatter — 60d Ratio ROC vs 20d Forward SPY Return
# =============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='Copper/Gold 60d ROC vs SPY 20d Forward Return',
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    x_axis_label='Cu/Au Ratio 60d ROC (%)',
    y_axis_label='SPY 20d Forward Return (%)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=roc_60d, y_values=(fwd_spy_20d,))

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Overall Stats + Rising vs Falling Regime
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Copper/Gold Ratio as SPY Leading Indicator',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Overall', 'Ratio Rising (ROC > 0)', 'Ratio Falling (ROC ≤ 0)'],
        col_headers=['Pearson Corr / Avg Fwd Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Observations'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    ),
    category='Copper/Gold Leading Indicator',
    order=2
)(corr_roc_fwd, obs_count, obs_count, fwd_spy_rising, hit_rising, rising_count, fwd_spy_falling, hit_falling, falling_count)
